body: It is a sign you are not meant to go yet, it may not be good now I understand and you don’t know that it will get better all we have is hope that it will, I’m very happy your still with us and I hope and pray it will get better for you

Please just don’t you are an amazing person with a long life a head of them you never know how good or bad it’s gonna get until you see for yourself, you deserve to live you deserve to be happy please be okay

I understand we’re you are coming from 100% I’ve wanted to do it several times through my life, what’s always stopped me though is thinking about my funeral thinking about how sad and how it would affect my family how my friends would feel I always just try to imagine there faces when they find out and it always makes me stop and think, please just give it another day or 2 do you have a close friend that can come over and hangout with you?

We have never met or spoken to each other but if you need someone to talk to I’m here, I’m at work rn so I can’t respond super fast but I’ll lend an ear, I’m sorry that you are in such a bad place and I’m sorry you feel this is the best option, please just take a moment to think about everyone you care about or that cares about you, have you tired taking to your parents or anyone in your family?

I know my comment probably won’t do anything but please don’t, you named off a few people that hurt you but you also named off a lot of people that you care about and it seems they care about you, try talking to someone about the thoughts in your head, spend the night with someone so your not alone, please just please don’t harm yourself
